input_fields.name: observation
input_fields.description: One caller-provided measured property record from an already completed reimport.

input_fields.name: expected_value
input_fields.description: One expected scalar, text, boolean, or flat numeric vector.

input_fields.name: expected_artifact_sha256
input_fields.description: Expected hash of the reimported/export artifact.

input_fields.name: absolute_tolerance
input_fields.description: Finite nonnegative tolerance; default may be zero.

result_fields.name: artifact_sha256
result_fields.description: Reimported artifact hash used for binding.

result_fields.name: runtime_observed
result_fields.description: Always false; host helper does not import or observe SpaceClaim.

procedure: Validate one reimport observation and compare its artifact hash with expected_artifact_sha256.
Compare exactly one property using the supported scalar/text/boolean/flat-vector semantics.
Return the flat host result with actual/expected values and runtime_observed=false.
Do not import, reopen, or inspect a second property in this atom.
rejection_rules: Reject wrong source_kind/action_id, unmeasured observation, missing identity/ref, hash mismatch, unsupported value shape, or invalid tolerance.
Do not claim MA-35/import success from this comparison.
Do not add a second property check.
